message.name: MOVING_BASE_REFERENCE
message.description: Vehicle-mounted navigation reference, not aircraft odometry or arming permission. Protocol version 1. Invalid quantities must not be consumed. No position or lever-arm compensation. Receiver must detect source reboot and estimator changes.
message.field: Reference publication time, not UART transmission time.
Attitude sample time in sender boot clock; zero means unavailable.
Velocity sample time in sender boot clock; zero means unavailable.
Angular velocity sample time in sender boot clock; zero means unavailable.
Hamilton quaternion w,x,y,z, body FRD to earth NED.
North, east, down velocity at source navigation reference point.
Bitmask: 1 tilt, 2 heading, 4 horizontal velocity, 8 vertical velocity, 16 angular velocity. Zero means no valid reference.
